fields.description: Optional. Inputs sharing the SAME group are filled together (a bundle). Bundles compete only within the same Exclusive Set. e.g. put both From Date and To Date in group 'date_range' so they stay together.
fields.label: Exclusive Group

fields.description: Optional. The exclusivity scope. Bundles (Exclusive Groups) sharing the same Exclusive Set are mutually exclusive — filling one clears the others in that set. Bundles in DIFFERENT sets are independent, so you can have several separate either/or choices on one template. Blank = the default shared set. e.g. set 'period' on the Fiscal-Year and Date-Range bundles, and 'party' on the Customer and Supplier bundles — picking a period won't touch the party choice.
fields.label: Exclusive Set
